c1-control.reason: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch' (torch is an optional extra; venv lacked it)

c2-control.reason: RuntimeError: AgentV SDK is unavailable; run npm ci in the checkout or set AGENTV_RUNNER

conclusion: Both cycles were pure environment-bootstrap blockers in a fresh container, not lever findings: (1) the repo venv had no torch installed (torch is declared as an optional `[torch]` extra in pyproject.toml, not a base dependency) -- fixed with `uv pip install -e ".[torch]"`; (2) the AgentV eval publisher requires the Node/TS toolchain from `npm ci`, which failed until `NODE_OPTIONS` (preset to `--import tsx --max-old-space-size=8192` in this environment) was unset for the npm invocation, since Node rejects `--import` inside NODE_OPTIONS for `npm ci`'s bootstrap phase. Both are self-heal, not harness bugs to file. Cycles c3-c5 in this session ran with a working environment.
next_priorities: Consider documenting the two-step bootstrap (uv pip install -e '.[torch]'; NODE_OPTIONS= npm ci) in a setup script or session-start hook so future fresh containers don't burn a cycle each on the same two blockers
